run: Harbourline Studio Ltd, September 2026 month-end supplier payment run

revision_history.note: First issue, handed to the scheduler in mail #4. Three items were with the principal (mail #3).

The principal's answers (mail #5) are recorded. R06 is approved and is now schedulable. R05 stays on HOLD and goes in the FX run on 2026-10-07, not in this run. R11 is declined and is to be treated as suspected fraud, so its decision moves from hold to exclude. Summary, totals, legend, principal_items, supplier_master_checks and run_notes updated to match. No other decision changed.

inputs_used: Extractor hand-off (mail #2) and work/invoices.json (records R01 to R11)
data/bank_feed.json (main current account, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-29; it foots: opening 41,382.17 plus credits less debits equals closing 46,440.98, so DR is money out and CR is money in)
Revision 2: the principal's answers (mail #5), and the scheduler's mail #6 with work/payment_run.json, which I opened because the scheduler pointed me at it. It agreed with revision 1 of this file.
payment_date_per_policy: Friday 2026-10-02: the second working day of October 2026 (Thursday 1 October is the first). Confirmed by the scheduler (mail #6). The principal's approval of R06 names the same date (mail #5).

principal_decisions.source: Mail #5 from human (the principal), 2026-09-29, answering the reconciler's mail #3. Quoted word for word.
verbatim: 1. Northfield bank details: declined. Do not update the details; pay Northfield to the details on file. I will call them on the number on file myself; treat the .co email as suspected fraud.
2. Marlow MD-2026-057: approved. Pay 5,400.00 GBP in this run on 2 October.
3. Kestrel 7731: hold. Do not pay it in this run; it goes in the FX run on 7 October. Keep it on the run as HOLD.

applied_as.R11: Declined. Not applied. Pay Northfield to the details on file. Suspected fraud. The principal makes the call-back themselves.
applied_as.R06: Approved for payment in this run on 2026-10-02. Schedulable now. Approval reference: mail #5.
applied_as.R05: HOLD. Not paid in this run. To be paid in the FX run on 2026-10-07. Kept on this run as HOLD.

summary.note: All three items put to the principal in mail #3 were answered in mail #5 (see principal_decisions). Nothing is waiting on the principal. R05 stays on the run as HOLD for the FX run on 2026-10-07. R11 is declined and is not payable.
summary.message_12: Evergreen marketing email. Not a document, no record (see messages_without_a_record).

totals.held_note: R05 (USD 960.00) is not paid in this run and is not in the GBP total. It goes in the FX run on 2026-10-07.

legend.pay: Valid, unpaid, payable in this run. If principal_approval_needed is true the payment may be scheduled only once the principal's approval has been received (approved_by and approval_reference show it).
legend.hold: Not to be paid in this run and kept on the run as HOLD. R05 only: the principal decided it goes in the FX run on 2026-10-07.
legend.exclude: Nothing is paid for this document: already paid, voided, superseded, duplicate, refunded, not an invoice, or a request that the principal has declined.
legend.amount_to_pay: Cash amount for that document once released: the invoice gross in its own currency, with nothing offset. 0.00 where nothing is paid. For a HOLD it is the amount held. It is not permission to schedule; use schedulable_now for that.
legend.variance_net: Invoice net minus PO net, in the currency of the PO. Positive means the invoice is above the PO. Item 4 tolerance is 50.00 net.
legend.schedulable_now: true where the scheduler may schedule the payment in this run: valid, and either no approval is needed or the principal's approval has been received.

decisions.reason: Already paid. The bank feed shows 1488.00 debited on 2026-09-18 with the reference NORTHFIELD PRINT INV-000482. The amount equals the invoice gross and the reference carries the invoice number. Item 6: excluded from the run. PO-1041 net 1240.00 matches the invoice net exactly.

Voided by the supplier on 2026-09-08 (R03): raised in error, nothing due, delivery already in the price agreed on PO-1041. No later message reinstates it, it came from the supplier's usual address, and the PO-1041 description says the run was 'delivered', which agrees. No 114.00 payment is on the bank feed. A voided invoice is not a valid invoice (item 1), so it is excluded. No variance test is made because nothing is payable. For the record: PO-1041 net 1240.00 is fully used by INV-000482, so a further 95.00 net would have been 95.00 over the PO, above the 50.00 tolerance. That question does not arise because the invoice is void.
Not an invoice and carries no amount. It is the notice that voids INV-000488 (R02) and is the reason R02 is excluded.

Already refunded, so nothing is offset (item 7). The supplier said it refunded 300.00 on 2026-09-09; the bank feed shows 300.00 received on 2026-09-10 with the reference MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND. The amount equals the credit note gross and the reference names the credit note. The one-day difference is ordinary transfer timing. The credit is therefore NOT deducted from MD-2026-057, which is paid at its full gross (R06).

decisions.approval_basis: Policy item 10, a situation the policy does not cover. Item 2 fixes the run in GBP from the main current account; this invoice is in USD and asks for a wire to the USD account on file. The policy has no rule for a non-GBP invoice and gives no exchange rate. Item 3 is not the trigger: USD 960.00 is under 2000.00 at any realistic rate.
decisions.approval_status: decided by the principal on 2026-09-29 (mail #5): hold. Not paid in this run; it goes in the FX run on 7 October; kept on the run as HOLD.
decisions.principal_decision_verbatim: Kestrel 7731: hold. Do not pay it in this run; it goes in the FX run on 7 October. Keep it on the run as HOLD.
decisions.release: FX run on 2026-10-07 (principal, mail #5). Not in this run and not in the GBP total.
decisions.reason: HOLD by the principal's decision (mail #5): not paid in this run, paid in the FX run on 2026-10-07, and kept on this run as HOLD. Everything about the invoice checks out: USD 960.00 equals the PO-1046 net in the same currency (variance 0.00), the sender domain kestrelcloud.com matches the master, the master holds the USD account the invoice refers to, and the invoice gives no bank details of its own. It is not on the bank feed, which covers the GBP account only. Nothing has been converted (no rate in the policy) and it must not be converted or scheduled in this run. The FX run on 2026-10-07 is before the 2026-10-12 due date, so it will not be paid late. The invoice is reverse charge (no VAT on it); Harbourline accounts for the VAT on its own return.

decisions.approval_basis: Policy item 3: a single payment of 5400.00 gross is above 2000.00 and needs the principal's approval before it is scheduled.
decisions.principal_decision_verbatim: Marlow MD-2026-057: approved. Pay 5,400.00 GBP in this run on 2 October.
decisions.reason: Valid and unpaid: nothing on the bank feed matches 5400.00 or MD-2026-057, and the only Marlow line on the feed is the 300.00 refund of CN-012. The invoice net 4500.00 equals PO-1039 net 4500.00 exactly. Pay the invoice gross, 5400.00, in full: credit note CN-012 was already refunded (see R04), so nothing is offset (item 7). It arrived twice (R06 and R09) but is one invoice number and is paid once (item 5). The invoice email carries no bank details and comes from the domain on the master, so pay to the details on file. The payment is above 2000.00, so item 3 required the principal's approval before scheduling; the principal approved it in mail #5, for payment in this run on 2026-10-02, so it can now be scheduled with that reference. Due 2026-10-15.

Superseded. The supplier corrected INV-000491 on 2026-09-17 under the same number (R08) and the latest version supersedes earlier ones (item 5). Version 1 is not paid and is not to be added to version 2: pay 378.60 once, not 372.60 plus 378.60. For the record version 1 was 10.50 net over PO-1044.

decisions.approval_basis: Not needed: 378.60 gross is 2000.00 or less (item 3). The variance of 15.50 net is within the 50.00 tolerance (item 4), so it is not escalated.

pay_to.warning: Do NOT use the account named in the R11 email. The principal declined that change request (mail #5) and said to treat it as suspected fraud (see R11).

decisions.reason: Latest version of INV-000491 and the only one to pay (item 5). Pay the invoice gross, 378.60, not the PO amount (item 2). Variance against PO-1044: invoice net 315.50 minus PO net 300.00 = +15.50 (about 5.2 percent), within the 50.00 tolerance; accepted and recorded (item 4). Reason for the variance, as given by the supplier and not independently checked against a price list: letterheads are charged at the agreed 82.75 per thousand (2,000 sheets = 165.50) plus business cards 150.00 = 315.50 net; PO-1044 records only a 300.00 total, so the PO-side split is not visible. The PO match stands on its own evidence: the PO-1044 description (business cards, 10 boxes; letterheads, 2,000) matches the invoice lines, although R08 does not restate the PO number and the extractor carried it over from R07. Not on the bank feed, so unpaid. Under 2000.00, so the agents schedule it without approval. Pay to the details on file, not to the account in R11 (item 8); the principal confirmed this in mail #5 and did not ask for the payment to be held. Due 2026-10-16, after the run date, but item 1 pays every valid unpaid invoice received by 30 September in this run.

Duplicate of R06: same invoice number, same amounts, same due date, re-sent unchanged on 2026-09-22. An invoice number is paid at most once (item 5), so R06 carries the single payment and this copy adds nothing.

A statement is not an invoice (item 1). It shows a balance of 0.00 at 2026-09-24; the opening 142.80 was cleared by the payment of 2026-09-03, which the bank feed confirms (142.80 debited, reference EVERGREEN OFFICE EO-55120). Nothing is owed. PO-1047 (Evergreen, stationery, net 180.00, raised 2026-09-22) has no invoice in the inbox, so nothing is payable against it: the PO amount is never paid without an invoice (item 2). An invoice for it arriving after 30 September belongs to the October run.

decisions.approval_basis: Policy items 8, 9 and 10: payment details change only with the principal's approval after a call-back on the phone number already on file. An email is never sufficient. Agents do not email or phone suppliers, so the call-back and any reply belong to the principal.
decisions.approval_status: decided by the principal on 2026-09-29 (mail #5): declined
decisions.principal_decision_verbatim: Northfield bank details: declined. Do not update the details; pay Northfield to the details on file. I will call them on the number on file myself; treat the .co email as suspected fraud.

requested_details.status: DECLINED by the principal (mail #5). NOT approved, NOT applied, NOT to be used for any payment. Suspected fraud.

sender_check.other_northfield_messages: messages 1, 2, 3, 7 and 8 all came from accounts@northfield-print.co.uk, which matches the master

decisions.reason: Declined by the principal (mail #5): do not update the details, pay Northfield to the details on file, treat the .co email as suspected fraud. The principal will make the call-back on the number on file themselves. Nothing is paid for this document. It was never applied: it came by email only, from a domain that does not match the supplier master, with a different display name and sign-off from every genuine Northfield message, both the sort code and the account number differ from what is on file, and it carries pressure cues (URGENT, payments to the old account bounce after 30 September, please reply) and names no invoice. Item 8 says an email is never sufficient. The supplier master was not edited and nothing was sent to the sender; do not reply to it. All Northfield payments go to the details on file (see R08). If the principal's call-back ever shows a genuine change, that would be a new decision and a new approval, not a reading of this request.

messages_without_a_record.what: Marketing email for a 15 percent autumn discount
messages_without_a_record.reason: Not an invoice (item 1: statements, reminders and marketing emails are not invoices). It states no amount due and asks for nothing about payment.

principal_items.decision_needed: Whether to call Northfield back on the number on file to check the bank-details change request and, only after that, whether to approve a change.
options: (a) The principal calls +44 20 7946 0810 (the number on file, not anything in the email). If confirmed, approve the change; if not, treat the email as an attempted payment diversion and do not reply to it.
(b) No further action: Northfield keeps being paid to the details on file.
(c) As (a), and also hold Northfield's 378.60 out of this run until the call-back is done.
principal_items.reconciler_view: (a), with 378.60 going to the details on file in the meantime
principal_items.outcome: Declined. Do not update the details; pay Northfield to the details on file. The principal will call Northfield themselves on the number on file. Treat the .co email as suspected fraud. Northfield INV-000491 is not held.

principal_items.decision_needed: Approve or decline paying Marlow MD-2026-057, GBP 5,400.00 gross, in this run.
options: (a) Approve: it can be scheduled for 2026-10-02.
(b) Decline or defer: it misses this run and the next run pays on 2026-11-03, after its 2026-10-15 due date.
principal_items.outcome: Approved. Pay 5,400.00 GBP in this run on 2 October.

principal_items.decision_needed: How to pay a USD 960.00 invoice when the run is made in GBP from the main current account. The policy has no rule for a non-GBP invoice and gives no exchange rate.
options: (a) Approve a USD 960.00 wire from the main account to the USD account on file, with the bank converting at its rate on the day.
(b) Pay it from a USD balance if the company holds one (the reconciler can only see the GBP account).
(c) Leave it out of the run and pay it separately before its 2026-10-12 due date.
principal_items.outcome: Hold. Not paid in this run; it goes in the FX run on 7 October. Kept on the run as HOLD.

sender_domains_seen.northfield-print.co: does NOT match the master (message 11, the change request)

supplier_master_checks.outcome: Pay to the details on file. Change request R11 was declined by the principal (mail #5) and is to be treated as suspected fraud. The master is unchanged.
No bank details in any Marlow email. Pay to the details on file; the principal approved the payment (mail #5).

A USD account is on file, which agrees with the invoice's 'pay by wire to the USD account on file'. The invoice changes nothing about how Kestrel is paid. On HOLD by the principal's decision: it goes in the FX run on 2026-10-07, not in this run.

run_notes: Variance accepted (item 4): INV-000491 version 2, Northfield Print Ltd, PO-1044. Invoice net 315.50 against PO net 300.00 is +15.50 (about 5.2 percent), within the 50.00 tolerance. Paid at the invoice gross, 378.60. Reason as given by the supplier: letterheads charged at the agreed 82.75 per thousand (2,000 sheets = 165.50) plus business cards 150.00; PO-1044 records only a 300.00 total, so the PO-side split is not visible. Version 1 (net 310.50, +10.50) is superseded.
Credit note CN-012 (Marlow, gross 300.00): already refunded, bank feed 2026-09-10 CR 300.00 MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND. Nothing offset (item 7). MD-2026-057 is paid at its full gross.
Excluded as already paid (item 6): INV-000482, Northfield, 1,488.00, paid 2026-09-18 per the bank feed.
Excluded as voided: INV-000488, Northfield, 114.00 gross, voided by the supplier on 2026-09-08.
Excluded as superseded (item 5): INV-000491 version 1, 372.60. Excluded as duplicate (item 5): the second copy of MD-2026-057 (message 9).

Excluded as not an invoice (item 1): Evergreen statement of 2026-09-24 (balance 0.00; the 142.80 opening balance was paid 2026-09-03 per the bank feed) and the Evergreen marketing email of 2026-09-28. PO-1047 (Evergreen, 180.00 net) has no invoice, so nothing is payable against it.

Bank details (item 8): the Northfield change request of 2026-09-26 (R11) was declined by the principal in mail #5: do not update the details, pay Northfield to the details on file, treat the .co email as suspected fraud. The principal will make the call-back on the number on file themselves. The supplier master was not touched and nothing was sent to the sender.

Approval (item 3): Marlow MD-2026-057, GBP 5,400.00, is above the 2,000.00 threshold. The principal approved it in mail #5 (2026-09-29) for payment in this run on 2 October. Approval reference: mail #5.

Kestrel Cloud 7731 (USD 960.00) is kept on the run as HOLD by the principal's decision (mail #5): not paid in this run, it goes in the FX run on 7 October, which is before its 12 October due date. The policy does not cover a non-GBP invoice in a GBP run (item 10). Nothing converted and not in the GBP total.

Due dates: Marlow 2026-10-15 and Northfield 2026-10-16 fall after the payment date of 2026-10-02, but item 1 pays every valid unpaid invoice received by 30 September in this run, so neither is deferred for its due date.
The other bank-feed lines (rent, PAYE, Loom subscription, the Brightwater receipt) relate to no supplier document in this run.
limits_and_not_checked: The reconciler worked from the extractor's records (work/invoices.json) and did not read the raw emails. The extractor's figures were re-added (net plus VAT equals gross on every invoice and credit note) and agree with the PO list where a PO applies.
The extractor states that email attachments are not in the export, so figures come from the email bodies.

The bank feed covers 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-29 and shows amounts and references only, not the beneficiary account. 'Already paid' therefore rests on amount plus reference. A payment made on 30 September would not show. If a newer feed is available before scheduling, the already-paid test should be repeated.

The August invoice MD-2026-049 (the one CN-012 credits) is not in the inbox and its payment of 2026-08-28 is before the feed period. The CN-012 decision rests on the refund line in the feed, not on that invoice.
No exchange rate is available to the reconciler and none has been assumed.
